description: This is a Kotlin source file defining the HomeActivity class for an Android TV application. It manages the main home screen UI, including a top menu and multiple horizontally scrolling content rails loaded via ViewModel with coroutine flows. It also handles focus behavior and navigation to other activities.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity representing the TV home screen with menus and content rails.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates layout, sets up menu and content rails, triggers data loading.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Configures the top menu buttons with focus and click behavior.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Sets up the content rails with category titles, listens to ViewModel state, and populates content cards.
